senses.gloss: m. (preced.) the quantity collected on emptying the wine or oil press (v. next w.); in gen. bottle, keg as a measure.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 10:8">Ter. X, 8</cite> <he>וכל ג׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. (ed. <he>כל</he>) and one measured the keg and it contained (as usual) two S’ah.—Pl. <he>גְּרָבִים</he>, constr. <he>גַּרְבֵי</he>.
Sabb. 13ᵇ; a. e. three hundred ג׳ שמן garab of oil.
